app_summary: Turn video and audio into text and subtitles
app_description: Transcribes video and audio files with a Whisper model that runs on this computer, through ruscawhisper-engine, and saves the text as Markdown and the subtitles as SRT. Nothing leaves the machine.
ai_note: Design, specifications and testing by the author; code written with the assistance of AI tools.
guide_missing: The user guide is not installed.
log_empty: The engine has not written anything yet.
empty_title: Transcribe a Video or Audio File
empty_desc: Speech recognition runs on this computer: nothing is sent over the internet.
completed: Transcription completed. Review it and save.
discard_body: The transcription has not been saved: if you continue it will be lost.
banner_no_engine: ruscawhisper-engine is not installed: install it to use RuscaDubbing.
banner_no_model: No model found: copy one into the models folder.
err_no_ffmpeg: FFmpeg is not installed: it is needed to read video and audio.
err_audio: Could not read the audio of the file
err_engine: Speech recognition stopped with an error
model_hint: Whisper models in ggml format (.bin files), for example ggml-large-v3-turbo.bin. Larger models are more accurate and slower.
gpu_sub: Much faster; turn off if the driver gives problems
threads_sub: This computer has {n} physical cores: use as many
font_size_sub: Ctrl++ and Ctrl+− change it, Ctrl+0 returns to the system size
